_doc: Ready-made trips per region for one, two and three weeks (Manu, 2026-11-14), written by hand: the zones you sleep in (globe place ids) and the nights in each, in travel order. Each zone has a hand-written area in todo.json / areas/*.json, whose ranked things fill the days. level = the highest effort (rubric 0-5, docs/RANKING.md) among the zones' first things; pace: relaxed = 3+ nights a base, normal, intense = 1-2. Loaded by app.guide.ready; used by app.services.explore.propose when no stop was kept or dropped.

trips.title: Glaciers and Fitz Roy in a week
trips.why: Two bases only: Perito Moreno from El Calafate, then four nights under Fitz Roy to catch a clear day.

trips.title: Patagonia classic: Fitz Roy, Torres del Paine, Ushuaia
trips.why: The three big parks of the south with a weather day in each, then the end of the world.

trips.title: Patagonia from the Atlantic to the lakes
trips.why: Penguins on the Atlantic (whales too until December), the far south, the two great parks, and the lakes and volcanoes to end.

trips.title: Hanoi, the bays and Hoi An in a week
trips.why: The north's karst by boat twice, Ha Long and Ninh Binh, then a flight to the lanterns of Hoi An.

trips.title: Vietnam north to south in two weeks
trips.why: Hanoi, a night on Ha Long Bay, the terraces of Sapa, the emperors of Hue, Hoi An and Saigon.

trips.title: Vietnam in three weeks, with the Ha Giang Loop
trips.why: The far north by road, the caves of Phong Nha, the old capitals of the centre, and the Mekong to end.
